info.description: One Courier agent moving on the model's own path network (`network`) instead of continuous space: it starts at a node named "Dock", is sent to a node named "Dropoff" the instant it starts, and enters Delivered on arrival. Needs the model to declare those two node names and a segment joining them -- validation reports E_AGENT_SPACE with a clear hint if they are missing. move_to's travel time is segment length / speed, exact, so a fixed leg gives an exact sojourn oracle just like the continuous walker asset.
